detail.longDescription: I've been messing with GetSystemMetric function on VBA, trying to automate workbook zoom based on screen size. At the company I work, most monitors are FHD, however, due to actual screen size and user preference, people tend to personalize the zoom option on the Windows system. I've found solutions for one monitor, however, whenever I try those on my set up with a laptop and an external monitor I only get results for the main monitor for both zoom and size. I want to be able to get the results for whichever monitor my Excel sheet is active on. I need my macro to identify which monitor the Excel sheet os active on (either monitor 1 or 2) get the resolution of the monitor and the zoom setting for that specific monitor. With these information, I can automate the Excel zoom setting to make my workbook fullscreen on any screen. The idea is that, If i move my workbook from monitor 1 (FHD, 125% Windows zoom setting) to my monitor 2 (also FHD but much larger, 100% windows zoom setting) the Excel zoom setting (lower right corner of the workbook) changes automatically from 100% to 125%. I've found solutions only for Screen resolution and DPI that only work for main monitor, and that's not what I need. In summary, my two main problems are: Getting the size of each monitor conected to the machine Getting the zoom setting of each screen Basically getting these numbers:
